{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Talon Squadron''''' was a [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wing]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] commanded by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]].

The Squadron was used by Tarrak to provide cover for [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Boegis Squadron]] to [[Ambush on Hashim|disable]] 3 [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Modified corvettes]] called [[Hashim group|''Hashim'']]. After disabling them, a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|transport]], ''[[Dhoora]]'' boarded and captured ''[[Hashim 1]]'', which contained a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototype. The strike team then escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
